# flutter_data_kit

Pub workspace: core contracts + Dio/Supabase/Drift adapters. Depends on
lemsa_core_kit (AppFailure, Change). Core has no dio/supabase/firebase/drift.
Adapters map vendor exceptions to AppFailure. Drift owns mapDrift,
DriftSyncQueue, deleteUserData. PagedList mixin + ref.cacheFor (do not cache
failed fetches). FVM 3.35.7. Firebase adapter is still a stub.
